leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Express.js endpoint to handle file uploads using multer middleware
Configure multer storage settings to specify destination and filename patterns
Implement file type validation by checking MIME types or extensions
Apply file size limits to prevent oversized uploads
Initialize error handling for upload failures and validation errors
Integrate validation logic with the upload endpoint to reject invalid files
Manipulate file metadata to generate unique filenames and organize uploads
lessonTitle: Build file upload endpoint with validation
